configuration.pipeline: production prepare_context; existing complementary density hybrid configuration

definitions.evidence_retention: Retained word/punctuation footprint of unioned exact evidence spans in gold supporting passages / total footprint of those spans. Headers excluded. Distinct from unweighted source recall.
definitions.actual_context_tokens: len(re.findall(r"\w+|[^\w\s]", rendered_context)); includes actual chunk headers.
definitions.context_reduction: (raw_context_footprint-selected_context_footprint)/raw_context_footprint; same renderer and word/punctuation counter on both sides.
definitions.gold_claim_coverage: Missing: no explicit required/gold claim-ID annotation exists. Null, never replaced silently.
definitions.supporting_passage_claim_coverage: Distinct canonical claim IDs retained / union of canonical claim IDs in gold supporting passages. Existing harness definition; includes incidental facts and is not a minimal answer-fact metric.
definitions.independent_evidence_coverage: Union of annotated root-origin units represented by retained GOLD passages / union represented by all gold supporting passages. Edges are declared upstream, citation and parent-observation references. Root cycles collapse to one unresolved origin unit. No estimator weights, temporal similarity or dependency-cluster threshold are used.
definitions.dependency_cluster_coverage: Separate reused diagnostic: distinct required-claim/estimated-cluster pairs covered. Not independent-origin coverage.
definitions.source_metrics: Existing score_selection precision and recall against all annotated supporting sources; unchanged denominators.
definitions.budget: Original Qwen2.5 7B tokenizer units, exact rendered context. Word/punctuation footprint is a separate measurement and can exceed the numeric tokenizer budget.
definitions.budget_normalized_source_recall: Reused exact rendered-subset feasibility ceiling for the recorded method-specific renderer order; never the passage-count formula.
definitions.selection_ms: Fresh wall time after supplied relevance scores and canonical observations are available. Baselines: sorting, first-fit packing, rendering. Hybrids: full prepare_context including fresh graph evaluation, discovery, packing, reconstruction and SDK validation. No evaluation receipt reuse.
definitions.timing_exclusions: Dataset loading, semantic model initialization AND model relevance inference excluded for every arm. Exact tokenizer counts prewarmed for every possible whole-chunk subset/order used by the harness. Local daemon startup excluded; its graph requests are included.
definitions.graph_ms: SDK-reported server graph execution duration. MCP roundtrip and client verification inference are separate, overlapping components; do not sum them.
definitions.packing_ms: SDK chunk_selection_latency_ms includes proposal rendering/token checks; baseline pack duration excludes sorting and final render.
definitions.percentiles: Linear interpolation at (n-1)q over all recorded execution samples; quality metrics macro-average unique case-budget cells, not repeats.
definitions.cost: Paid API cost for this local selection-only execution is 0.00 USD; excludes hardware/electricity and historical work.

limitations: No downstream generation or answer-accuracy claim.
Independent origins are annotation-relative; absent links do not prove real-world independence. Citation edges use the existing annotation contract, not new entailment judgments.
Gold source labels do not specify a minimal set of answer-required atomic claims.
Selection timing is post-relevance; it is not full BGE/MiniLM retrieval inference latency.
SDK runs use the supported isolated local daemon without SQLite persistence.
